title: A Primer of the Pistol Grip
summary: Teaches the one-handed grip, stance and sight line of the pistol to a beginner with no qi.

title: Handbook of Powder and Ball
summary: Drills the charging, ramming and priming of a pistol for students who have only begun to harden the skin.

title: The Pistoleer's Plain Draw Book
summary: Sets out the belt draw and quick levelling of the pistol for students building strength in the arm and shoulder.

title: Workbook of the Steady Wrist
summary: Trains the wrist and forearm tendons to hold the pistol still through the shot and the recoil.

title: Short Treatise on Close Muzzle Work
summary: Teaches fighting with the pistol at arm's length and in the clinch, for students with hardened bone.

title: Drill-Book of the Pan and Hammer
summary: Joins the first thread of circulated qi to the priming pan and hammer fall of the pistol.

title: Canon of the Level Barrel
summary: Teaches qi-steadied aiming so that the barrel rises level and the shot breaks true.

title: The Sidearm Handbook of Quick Reloading
summary: Shortens the reload of a pistol with qi-warmed powder and practiced hands, for students who circulate qi.

title: Primer of the Clubbed Pistol
summary: Teaches the use of the empty pistol as a club and the barrel as a guard.

title: A Plain Guide to Cover and Pistol
summary: Shows how to shoot from behind walls, corners and tables and to move between them under fire.

title: Treatise on the Two-Shot Carry
summary: Teaches carrying and firing two pistols in turn so that the first empty piece costs no time.
